description: Connect two nodes together to create an execution flow

connection_index.description: Output of the source node to connect. For CONDITION nodes: 0 is the "true" output, 1 is the "false" output. Default 0

edge_type.description: Type of the connection, CONDITION for outputs of condition nodes

node_from.description: The source node ID (execution flows from this node)

node_to.description: The target node ID (execution flows to this node)

name: node_connect
